July 29 2026 — SearchSpring Snap card-click throw: clicking a PLP product card triggers `t.isImmediatePropagationStopped is not a function` thrown from SearchSpring's cross-origin Snap bundle (snapui.searchspring.io, store-functional, deliberately left loaded). Because it's cross-origin the browser redacts it (window.onerror 'Script error.'), and under Cypress it arrives as an unhandled rejection with a non-Error reject value that Cypress wraps as 'An unknown error has occurred: [object Object]' — which failed plp.cy.js 'clicking a product card navigates to the PDP'. Diagnosed live via chrome-devtools (no rejection on load; fires only on card click; site still works because the card href navigates). It surfaced when commit aedddf9 narrowed the uncaught:exception handler from the old blanket () => false. Not an FSE-fixable defect (SearchSpring's cross-origin code). Suppressed in cypress/support/e2e.js by extending the redacted-cross-origin arm to also match Cypress's opaque-rejection wrapper (/an unknown error has occurred/i) — the rejection-shaped equivalent of the existing 'cross origin script' suppression. RESOLVED SITE DEFECT (raised Sept 30 2026; fix confirmed live Oct 1 2026, when the checkout test passed): /checkout carried the same stopFunction2 bug as ADAP (and as BESTCA before its Sept 23 fix) — function stopFunction2(){ stopFunction2(myVar2); } at line 655, calling itself instead of clearInterval(myVar2). showTime2() polls every second for an empty .paymentProviderHeader-cc, fills in card icons, then calls stopFunction2(), so the RangeError fires as soon as the card-gateway header renders on the payment step — for every real customer too. Fix: clearInterval(myVar2). With only that error suppressed locally (never committed) the whole funnel passes, so the test goes green once the template is fixed.
